projects.title: Latency-aware placement of network functions at the edge
projects.overview: Doctoral research on running chains of virtual network functions across very different hosts at the network edge: virtual machines, containers, programmable switches and SmartNICs.
projects.problem: Network functions now run on mixed hardware. Placing a chain of them across that mix so that end-to-end latency stays low is a hard optimisation problem.
contribution: A taxonomy of heterogeneous frameworks for deploying virtual network functions.
Testbed measurements of what heterogeneous execution gains.
An integer linear programming model for hybrid placement that minimises end-to-end latency.
HYPHA, a heuristic that finds near-optimal hybrid placements quickly.
A dynamic placement scheduler based on optimal stopping theory.
outcomes: Three peer-reviewed publications: IEEE GLOBECOM 2023, IEEE NetSoft 2022 and Future Internet 2022.
